title: cenchrus caninus
intro: Cenchrus caninus, commonly known as the spurge grass or sandbur, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is a shrub-like plant with small white flowers and a prickly seed head. The health benefits of Cenchrus caninus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit anti-bacterial, anti-fungal, and anti-viral activities due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds.
